text: Finch's Big News is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal during the DLC Quest Most Awful News?!. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Info Collector" Field Skills.

Fancy Sundress Nia (Japanese: , Oshare Mizugi no Nia) is a DLC Accessory in . It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange after Chapter 7 for 45 Flawless Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. When equipped to Nia it changes her outfit to a yellow dress.

The Fiercest Fire is a crafting station in . It is a bonfire in Argentum's Goldmouth Res. Dist., and is used during the DLC quest Making Love Source to prepare Love Source, a pouch item that builds Trust by a large amount. After completion of the quest, more Love Source can be made here anytime.

Fane Buloofos (Japanese: , Fangu Urusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family and can be found at levels 2 and 8-9 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly in Lasaria Woodland and Haradd Hills.

Feeding an Army (Japanese: , Teikōgun no Shokuryō Mondai, The Resistance Army's Food Troubles) is a main story quest in . It can be received from Addam in the Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Kingdom of Torna.
Feris Quotelettas are Meat items in . They can be created by Jin at Campsites.

Feltley Village (Japanese: , Feruto-mura) is a landmark in . It is located just north of the Cropwoods of Yorn in the Lasaria Region, before Uccar's Trail. There are multiple Treasure Troves and Collection Points here, and the Crimson Slate Piece can be found here.
Fernyiges, Dark Zone #2 (Japanese: , Daini Kinku Ferunigeshu) is a landmark in . It is located in the Tornan Titan Interior, beyond the Crooked Tower. Pantarhei Tower is here.
Fierce Tempest (Japanese: ) is one of Haze's Rear Guard Arts in .
Fierce Talismans are Talismans in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites after completing My First Adventure.
Farsighted Talismans are Talisman items in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites.
Fisherman's Feasts are Seafood Pouch Items in . They can be created by Aegaeon at Campsites.
Fancy Seams are Mechanical collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Feris Beastmeats are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Firm Volffs (Japanese: , Ferumu Vorufu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Volff family and can be found at level 14 - 20 in the Serene Springside area and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.

Field Conversations are dialogue in that one or two characters take part in while speaking to NPCs. These exchanges usually takes place while speaking to appropriate NPCs during Quests, or accepting Merc Mission requests. The predetermined dialogue are grouped into reactions or intent. Which randomized conversation takes place depends on the current active party formation.

Fers Grebel (Japanese: , Farusa Tasuman) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Grebel family, and can be found at level 9 - 14 on Wayside Respite, Lascham Peninsula,Ordia Great Plains, and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott. Five must be defeated to unlock Haze's level 2 Cloudburst Blade Special.
Fernand is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Human and can be found in New Los Angeles.
The Firmament Ring is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.
Fair Game is a Time Attack challenge in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage. The challenge battle is located at Zax Guidepost.
Favour for Fofora (Japanese: , Rutorū no Onegai) is a quest in . It can be received from Fofora at Xen's Thoroughfare on Bionis' Shoulder. Completing it adds Fofora to the active Ponspectors.

Faifa (Japanese: , Sakusaku) is a Nopon in . She is a Ponspector of the blue team met at Abaasy's Dorsum on the Bionis' Shoulder. She has been Ponspecting for seven years and is interested in ecology and riddles. Faifa gives the quest Riddle Faifa This.

Finding Happiness (Japanese: , Kōfuku no Kangen) is a quest in . It can be received from Lott in just above the Grand Arch in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder. Before accepting the quest Lott will ask the party about what they saw on the way to Gran Dell and none of the choices will change anything except different dialogue Lott says.
Fixing Up the Junks (Japanese: , Jankusu no Shūri no tameni) is a quest in . It can be received from Helmaline at the Grand Arch in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder when Shulk is the party leader.

The Faded ID Tag is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It is dropped by the Somnivore Lexos appearing on its own on the way to Alcamoth. A conversation with Lavean mentions that his brother Sovean is missing and that the Somnivore Lexos was his sworn enemy. Upon defeating the Lexos the Faded ID Tag is acquired, and showing this to Lavean triggers Brother's Keepsake.
The First-Aid Kit is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It is given by Solthas during Steady on, Grandad!, and is required for completing this quest given by Miles.

Family Relations (Japanese: , Futatsu no Kazoku, A Family of Two) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located at the Skybridge on the Bionis' Shoulder, between Melia and Nene, once Teelan's Laboratory has been visited.

Festival Headbands are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing The Walls Have Eyes Time Attack challenge. They can only be worn by Dunban.
Festival Shirts are light torso armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing The Walls Have Eyes Time Attack challenge. They can only be worn by Dunban.
Festival Beads are light arms armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing The Walls Have Eyes Time Attack challenge. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Festival Shorts are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing The Walls Have Eyes Time Attack challenge. They can only be worn by Dunban.
Festival Sandals are light feet armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing The Walls Have Eyes Time Attack challenge. They can only be worn by Dunban.
Feather Typhoon (Japanese: , Fezātaifūn) is Roc's Level III Blade Special in . Feather Typhoon is also Roc's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Final Retribution (Japanese: ) is Herald's Level III Blade Special in .
Fierce Deluge (Japanese: ) is Praxis's Level III Blade Special in . Fierce Deluge is also Praxis's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Final Thrust (Japanese: , Fainarusurasuto) is Hugo's Level III Special in . As with Hugo's other specials, the element of Final Thrust is determined by the Arming Sword he has equipped.
Final Crow is Mikhail's Level III Blade Special in . Final Crow is also Mikhail's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Ferronises (Japanese: , Tetsu Kyoshin, lit. Iron Giant God) are huge mobile military bases in and .

Feisty-Spicy Zestbeans are meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked by purchasing the Yapolta Veggie-Beans from the Colony 9 Canteen for the first time.
Falcon Swoop (Japanese: , Farukonfōru, Lit. "Falcon Fall") is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Guardian Commander class. The user hops at the enemy with a downward slash.
Farewell Melody is a Standard Quest in . It can be received from Lenny in Yzana Plains.

Final Say (Japanese: , Indō o watashite yaru mo) is a Battle Art in . It is a variation of Extended Slash used only by Riku & Manana. Riku aims his electric screwdriver like a rifle and fires a shot at enemies.
The First Ixia Bridge (Japanese: , Daiichi Ikushia Ōhashi) is a Location in . It is located on the Syra Hovering Reefs and connects to Colony 11.

The First Pillar Remnant (Japanese: , Daiichi Sekichū Iseki) is a Landmark in . It is located on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. It is the remnant of one of pillars from the Chamber of Pillars in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Firearm Belts are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Tableland Caravan and Tunnel Caravan. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Troglodyte Umir.

Final Lucky Seven is one of Noah's unique Talent Arts in . This Talent art can be used by Noah regardless of class and is unlocked during the battle against the Queen of Agnus. In order to use this Talent Art, Noah must first use the Unlimited Sword Talent Art to unsheathe Lucky Seven.

Farlaine Underpass (Japanese: , Fāren Gankutsudō) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea, past Hermit's Inlet. It becomes accessible during Side Story: Taion. The Lost Colony is located beyond here.

Fang-King Clavein (Japanese: , Gajū-ō Kuravein) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Darbus family, and can be found at level 80 at the end of the Elgares Depths in Millick Meadows. The Counter Puncher Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Farseer Pirtett (Japanese: , Enken no Pirutetto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Hox family, and can be found at level 40 at Zem's Crossway in the Eagus Wilderness, northwest side of Ribbi Flats near Dies Arch. The Sacrificial Heal Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Fairscale Marina (Japanese: , Birin no Marīna) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 66 at Oshia's Reef Ravine in Erythia Sea. It forms the trio "Whirlpool Triumvirate" with Sharpscale Ragoon and Hardscale Gouran. The Breath of an Era Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Fineblade Faltaar (Japanese: , Tsubakazari no Farutāre) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Taos family, and can be found at level 47 north of the Material Storage Warehouse on the Great Sword's Hilt. The Dino Flash Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Fetos Sandgarden (Japanese: , Fetosu no Sunaniwa) is a Location in . It is located near Zorza's Stonehammer in the Dannagh Desert.
The Fallfoot Battlescar (Japanese: , Takishita no Senjō-ato) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Cotte Falls in the Pentelas Region.
The First Cataract (Japanese: , Daiichi no Taki) is a Location in . It is located at Great Cotte Falls, near the Cascade Ferronis Hulk.
Ferronis Arsenal #1: E. Gate (Japanese: , Daiichi Tetsukyoshin Kōshō: Higashi Gēto) is a Landmark in , located in the Origin Interior.
Ferronis Arsenal #1: S. Gate (Japanese: , Daiichi Tetsukyoshin Kōshō: Minami Gēto) is a Landmark in , located in the Origin Interior.
Ferronis Arsenal #3: E. Gate (Japanese: , Daisan Tetsukyoshin Kōshō: Higashi Gēto) is a Landmark in , located in the Origin Interior.
Ferronis Arsenal #3: N. Gate (Japanese: , Daisan Tetsukyoshin Kōshō: Kita Gēto) is a Landmark in , located in the Origin Interior.
Ferronis Arsenal #1 (Japanese: , Daiichi Tetsukyoshin Kōshō) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior. Kevesi Ferronises are built here.
Ferronis Arsenal #2 (Japanese: , Daini Tetsukyoshin Kōshō) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior.
Ferronis Arsenal #3 (Japanese: , Daisan Tetsukyoshin Kōshō) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior. Agnian Ferronises are built here.
Finite Time is a Standard Quest in . Alexandria has unique dialogue if she's in the party during this quest.

The Fifth Pillar Remnant (Japanese: , Daigo Sekichū Iseki) is a Landmark in . It is located on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. It is the remnant of one of pillars from the Chamber of Pillars in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.
Fire-Fighting Hydrojets are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Filling Onions are Collectible items in and . They can be found in the Aetia Region in . It can also be purchased from the Colony Gamma Caravan, or produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. In , they can be found in the Vermilion Woods. They can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New). Two are needed for the Vermilion Woods Collectopaedia.
Fire Apricots are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony 4 Caravan, or produced from the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Ferron Units are four Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Ferrons piloted by Colony 0 soldiers. They are fought alongside No. 7 at level 53 in Colony 0 on Captocorn Peak during Inhumanity.
Fine Ageshu Wings are items in . They can be dropped by Spartan Fennick and Etrekt Ageshus in Low Maktha Wildwood.
Fatty Serprond Fillets are items in and . They can be obtained from the Serprond family of enemies. The rare variant can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan.

Faroos Enpedias are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Enpedia family, and can be found at level 67-68 at Ferronis Arsenal #3, in the East-West Sector Passage and in the Hangar, Lower Level in the Origin Interior.
False Volffs are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 47 at Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region during Transparent Dreams.
Fili (Japanese: , Fugen) is a NPC in . Fili is from Colony Iota. After Inescapable Past is completed, Fili moves to Colony 30
Ferronis Hulks (Japanese: , Kuchita Tetsukyoshin, Fallen Iron Titan) are points of interest in .

Final Countdown (Japanese: , Fainarukauntodaun) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Soulhacker class. The damage dealt by this art increases for each Art or Skill obtained by the Soulhacker class.

Fighting Headbands are Accessories in and . They can be bought from the Nopon Coin X-change for 30 Silver Nopon Coins.

The Fermenting Bug Juices are a Key Item in . They are sweet smelling fluids that is obtained upon defeating the Sweet Plambus during A More Balanced Recipe. Manana uses it to make a delicious meal for Dorin and Bambam.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Feather Misangas are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Atoll Caravan, the legendary variant can be obtained from Gracious Titania. In , the legendary variant can be acquired from Fogtrawler Tallstuff.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Fire Bangles are Accessories in and .
Fish-Fillet Toasties are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Colony 30 Canteen. Purchasing it for the first time unlocks the Brisky-Breezy Toastie recipe for Manana's Menu.

Feyz Rhoguls are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and are fought at level 51 at the Material Storage Warehouse on the Great Sword's Hilt during Side Story: Sena.
Feather Sanctuary (Japanese: , Fezāsankuchuari) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Eunie's Ouroboros arts.

Ferron x Ferron is a Time Attack Challenge Battle in . It can be received from Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the second part of the Expansion Pass. Clearing this challenge with at least an A rank for the first time will unlock the Swimwear B outfit for Taion.
Fatal Bite is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Machine Assassin class. Fatal Bite is unlocked as a Master Art upon reaching Rank 10 with the class.
Fatal Barrage (Japanese: , Feitarubarejji) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Full Metal Jaguar class.

Fin of Fear is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Massive Georges while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Fast Recharge is a Status Effect in and . As its name implies, it grants improved recharge to the affected character; Keves cooldown timers will tick faster, Agnus arts will gain more charge per auto-attack or Art cancel, and Talent Arts will gain more charge upon a Role Action.
The Fallen Gate of Ulcaria (Japanese: , Urukaria Seimon-ato) is a Landmark in , located on Magwall Road on The Ragmos Desolation. It is the ruined Gates of Ulcaria from the Kingdom of Tantal.
Fairylight Fount (Japanese: , Yōkōchū no Izumi) is a location in , located in Vermilion Woods.
The Ferronis Circuit Board is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from the Colony Gamma Wreckage during Elevator Repairs.
Field Crafting is a mechanic in , that becomes available during the Quest Elevator Repairs.
Fish-and-Fungi Funbowl is a Meal item in . It can be cooked at Rest Spots. It is unlocked by obtaining the Funbowl Recipe.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = Fibrous Aspar Meats are collectibles in . They are dropped by Aspars.
Fattened Krodlax Sashimis are items in . They can be dropped by Hemish Krodlax in Yesterdale.

Feelings Upon This Melody is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track eleven of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track eleven of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is an orchestral version of Off-Seer - Noah. This song plays during the following moments: * Noah's send off of Crys during Side Story: Noah. * When See-Mee-Mee thinks about off-seers after sending off Radek during Serene Melody. * When Juniper reminisces about the Former Commander of Colony Tau during Off-Seeing Customs. * When Zeon asks Kite for his support during For Colony 9.

Feelings Risen to the Sky is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track six of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track six of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This track is an orchestral piece containing parts from both Off-Seer - Mio, and Off-Seer - Miyabi. This song plays during the following moments: * When Mio reveals that she and M had swapped bodies. * Miyabi's explanation of what she believes is the purpose of Off-seers. * When Noah and Mio play on their flutes to break Y's control over Miyabi, Cammuravi, Mwamba, and Hackt.
Familiv A is a Holofigure in . It depicts an Attack Familiv, and is obtained after defeating Void.
Familiv B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a Heal Familiv, and is obtained after defeating Void.
Familiv C is a Holofigure in . It depicts a Support Familiv, and is obtained after defeating Void.
Familiv D is a Holofigure in . It depicts a Jammer Familiv, and is obtained after defeating Void.
Familivs are Ultrafauna enemies in . There are only four known types of Familivs, and they only appear during the first phase of the final battle against Void. They are not listed in the Enemy Index.
Ferdus is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found on the outskirts of the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest The Ties That Bind.
Farlan is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in the Beraf Industry Ward in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Fast Lane Hairs II are light head armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Riki for the first time on the Battle Race course Twilight Speedway. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Hairs I are light head armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2000 for the first time with Riki in the Score Attack course Caterpile Circuit. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Tops I are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2200 for the first time with Riki in the Score Attack course Jungle Rumble. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Tops II are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Riki for the first time on the Battle Race course Midnight Forest. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 7500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Shoes II are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Riki for the first time on the Battle Race course Colony 9 Wild Ride. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5400 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Shoes I are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2800 for the first time with Riki in the Score Attack course Rural Road. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3600 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Knapsacks II are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Riki for the first time on the Battle Race course Blizzard Rally. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Knapsacks I are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2600 for the first time with Riki in the Score Attack course Valak Slalom. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Arms I are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2400 for the first time with Riki in the Score Attack course Alcamoth Orbital. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.

Fast Lane Arms II are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Riki for the first time on the Battle Race course Alcamoth at Dawn. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Riki.
Fionncas is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier who can be found at Poldis Circle in the Indoline Praetorium during Bana the Schemer.
Falchions are spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Viragos or white Puges.
Faithful Lightblades are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 25,200 Credits.
Faithful Lightblades II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 25,200 Credits.

Fossil Monkeys (Japanese: , Kaseki Saru) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest and Colony 6. According to their description, people call them living fossils because they are rarely sighted. One is required for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 7,900 Noponstones.

Flier Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Clima Fliers and Colony Fliers in Colony 6 or traded for. According to their description, they are highly water-resistant and they make for handy umbrellas. Six are needed for A Gutsy Trader.
Françoise (Japanese: , Furansowa) is a Homs in . She can be found near the Tranquil Square in the Residential District of Colony 9. She is married to Arnaut.

Fortune Feathers (Japanese: , Kōfuku no Hane) are collectables in . They can be found in Agniratha and Colony 6. They are fluffy feathers that originate on Bionis and sometimes float over to Mechonis. One is required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 15,800 Noponstones.

Flexible Selua Cells are Materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. Three are required for Level 4 Special in Colony 6. They can only be obtained from Largo Selua and the Active Impulso in the Bionis' Interior. According to their description, they are elastic cells that can be stretched even further if they are put in water. Three are needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 8,600 Noponstones.

Forget-You-Nots (Japanese: , Wasurenabana) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh and Colony 6. According to their description, they are flowers of celebration used at weddings and they are symbols of constancy. Two are required for A Place to Come Home to.

Fresh Armu Milks are rare materials in . They are only dropped by Baby Armus in Colony 9 and can be obtain via trading with Marcia or overtrading with Jolele. According to their description, they have a satisfying tang and they stay fresh for only thirty-six minutes and nine seconds. Three are needed for one route of Overworked and Underpaid.
The Fortress Entrance (Japanese: , Gunji-ku Seimon) is a landmark in . It is located in Colony 9, south from the Military District and north from the Central Plaza.
The Forest Sniper (Japanese: , Foresutosunaipu) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is an ether rifle, usable by Sharla. It is not effective against Mechon.

Flattened Flowers (Japanese: , Maichitta Hana) is a quest in . It can be received by Françoise at the Residential District, near Tranquil Square, in Colony 9. This quest is available once Tephra Cave is accessible after Colony 9 have been attacked by the Mechon. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

Forests of Gossip (Japanese: , Danshō no Shinrin) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, Dunban scowled when he named them and they make a lively sound in the wind.

Flame Frames (Japanese: , Fureimu Furēmu) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Mechonis Field initially, then in Colony 6 after the events at the Mechonis Core. According to their description, Flame Frames have lights fixed within them and Sharla named them with caution.
Flame Gear (Japanese: , Fureimugia) is a weapon in . It is one of Reyn's gunlances.

Freesia Cysts (Japanese: , Furījia Shisuto) are collectables in . They can be found in Agniratha and Colony 6. According to their description, they look like they bloomed from amethyst and touching their petals brings calm feelings.

This quest will expire if Colony 6 Reconstruction reaches 100%. For the Restoration (Japanese: , Anzen'na Fukkō no tame ni) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Gorman in Colony 6, once Satorl Marsh is accessible after the final events in Ether Mine. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment. If Making a New Path is completed prior to this quest, the monster blocking the path will not have to be defeated.

Flamiis (Japanese: , Furamī; English dub: ) are a species of aerial monsters in the . They are flamingo-like creatures (hence the name Flamii), tend to be found around water, and come in three colours; blue are likely to be non-aggressive, pink are likely to be aggressive and white are uncommon. Ageshu behave similarly to Flamii, and may be related.
Front Armour is medium torso armour in . It can be traded for with Arnaut and Talonyth.
Forest Caps (Japanese: , Mitsurin no Bōshi) are medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at Frontier Village.

The Forgotten Cave (Japanese: , Wasuresarareta Horaana) is a location in . It is located in Tephra Cave. It is not reachable until the events at the Mechonis Core. It is reached by falling down the hole just north of the Heavenly Window. It is a small area; falling down only leads to the dead end location Hidden Warehouse, with the Reckless Galdon, or the recently opened up path to the Spring of Grief, or Tephra Cavern. There is an earth Ether Crystal deposit here.

Food Delivery (Japanese: , Shokuryō Haitatsu) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Natalia, she can be found on the middle of the stairs leading to the Junks in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment. After receiving the Boxed Meal from Natalia, Theo gives the party the Deepwater Fish.

Flier Bloom Scales are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Happiness Fliers on the third digit of the Fallen Arm, or traded for. According to their description, sprinkling them on plants makes them bloom extraordinarily quickly. Two of them are required for Resolution - Father.

Flavel Andos (Japanese: , Furāberu Andosu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Andos family, and can be found at level 34 on Hovering Reefs 1, 3, 6, and 8 in the Eryth Sea during the day and night. They drop Sturdy Armour. Six of them are needed for The Deciphering Machine, given by Ruthan in Alcamoth, and four are needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction. They are the only enemies that drop Aqueous Andos Oil, three of which are needed for Mystery of Makna Ruins 3.

Flutes Kromars are minor enemies in . They are members of the Kromar family, and can be found at level 37 at the Eryth Sea, on Hovering Reef 6 and 7. Flutes Kromars can be found walking alongside Palti Kromars.
The Fortress Rear Entrance (Japanese: , Garahado Yōsai: Uraguchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the northern part of Sword Valley. It is an entrance into Galahad Fortress.
The Flash Shield Elfidar (Japanese: , Kōjunken Erufida) is a weapon in . It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn.
Forma Spears (Japanese: , Sanshisuimei no Yari, Spear of the Scenic Beauty) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban, and can be dropped by various high-levelled enemies.
Frigus Strikers (Japanese: , Hanabie no Tachi, Tachi of the Frigid Spring) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are swords wielded by Dunban.

Friendship Tokens (Japanese: , Yūjō no Sanshunojingi, The Three Sacred Treasures of Friendship) is a quest in . It can be received from Moritz near the bridge in the southwestern portion of the Residential District of Colony 9 with Reyn in the lead of the party. After this quest is completed, Reyn's Camaraderie skill line will be unlocked.

For a Friend (Japanese: , Yūjin no tameni) is a quest in . It can be received from Rozeal near the Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh. It is the first of three quests given by Rozeal. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.

This quest will expire after the events at the Meyneth Shrine. For My Loved One... (Japanese: , Aisuru Hito ni) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Zarkort south of the Digit 2 on the Fallen Arm, after accepting Food Delivery and speaking to Theo (the first objective). If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment. Once this quest is completed, Zarkort will offer To My Loved One.... It will expire after the events at the Meyneth Shrine.

Flailing Bracken (Japanese: , Bōin no Burakken) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 73 on the shore north of Anti-Air Battery 2. It is Sight aggressive and can be found in a flock with Opulent Flamii as well as Resplendent Flamii.

Flamii Waterfall Orbs are rare materials in . They can only be obtained by defeating some varieties of high-level Flamii. According to their description, they are palm-sized orbs that pour forth a torrent if broken.
Freezinate (Japanese: , Hiehie damo) is one of Riki's Ether arts in . Upon using it, Riki launches a chunk of ice to damage an enemy and inflict Chill.

The Fresh Algora Sap is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found at dawn (5:00 - 6:00) in the Sap Cave south of the Nopon Arch in Makna Forest. It is required to complete A Final Sweet Favour.

Flash Wisps (Japanese: , Furasshu Ranpusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 14 near the bridge to the Bask Cave Passage on Bionis' Leg during clear nights. They can drop the Glowing Wisp Fluid needed for Emergency Treatment.
Flamme Antols (Japanese: , Furāmu Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 22 near the Pod Depot outside Colony 6 before the events at Mechonis Core.

Fool Sardis (Japanese: , Fuuru Sādi) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Sardi family, and can be found at level 35 in Makna Forest, in the river between the Great Makna Falls and Seahorse Islet.

Frenzied Bana (Japanese: , Gyakujō no Bān) is a quest exclusive Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Pterix family carrying the Nopon Bana, and is the only enemy that appears in Frontier Village. It is fought at level 78 at Apex Lake in Frontier Village during Bana the Betrayer and after the events at Mechonis Core (Chapter 17). Bana is also fought as Diabolical Bana in .

The Freight Road (Japanese: , Kamotsuunpanro) is a landmark in . It is located at Colony 6, just south of the Freight Elevator. The first time it is accessed is after the party escapes from the Ether Mine, having defeated Xord. They are ambushed by Metal Face and a group of Mass-Produced Faces, and Dickson and Dunban join the party to fight before the Mechon are driven off by a Telethia. During Chapter 17, several Asha Telethia permanently populate the road, and when it is raining, two Kyel Lexos appear. This road was most likely used for transporting the Ether Crystals mined in the mines back to Colony 6 before the Mechon attacked. In the , a Time Attack portal can be found here.
The Flower Bracelet is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Finding it is the objective of Search Quest 1 in Frontier Village. It can be found underneath the entry bridge to Frontier Village.

The Fortress Pass Key is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Obtaining it is required to complete Lift Battle. It can be obtained by defeating the Sentinel Mechon in the 2nd Fuel Supply Room of Galahad Fortress.
Fresh Sardi Meats are rare materials in . They can obtained from Pawn Piranhax and the Lake Magdalena in Colony 9. Fresh Sardi Meats are also available via trade.

The Fortress Depths (Japanese: , Garahado Yōsai: Saishinbu) is a landmark in . It is located on the fourth basement floor, the lowest floor, of Galahad Fortress. Gold Face accompanied by Face Nemesis are fought here.
Fossilised Bones are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Deinos Sauros, Laeklit Mammuts, and Korlba Pterix in Makna Forest. Fossilised Bones are not otherwise available.

Flier Allure Scales are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Atmos Fliers in Colony 6 and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are an essential ingredient in love potions but adding too much of them will attract anything.
Flowers of Eryth Sea (Japanese: , Eruto-kai ni Saku Hana) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on Hovering Reef 2 in Eryth Sea, between Sharla and Riki at green affinity.

Flame Grenade is a Ranged Battle Art in . It is an Assault Rifle art, one of Cross's two initial arts and one of his five signature arts. This Art is functionally a single target variant of Burst Grenade.

Forfexes (Japanese: , Pagurusu) are crab-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a common sight along Mira's coastlines and waterways, and can be found in Primordia, Noctilum, Oblivia, and Sylvalum.
The Fragile Package is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Kenny Rohan during The Plan - The Night Before, and must be delivered to Sesame to complete the quest.
The FrontierNav (English dub: ) is an information system featured in .

Forest of the Nopon/Night (マクナ原生林／夜, Macuna Woods / Night) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 17 of disc 3 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard at night while the party is in Makna Forest.
Flamehand is one of H.B.'s two Signature Arts in . It is acquired after completing the Affinity Mission Climbing the Ladder.
Fosdyke (Japanese: , Fosudaiku) is a Human in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found on a bench at the south side of Deliverance Park during the day.

Forest Suids (Japanese: , Foresuto Zūsu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Suids and can be found at level 13 on Sapphire Table in Noctilum. Five must be defeated to complete the Basic Mission Suid Sweep.
Forest Femina Suids (Japanese: , Foresuto Femina Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Suids and can be found at level 12-13 at Old Dragontail Tree or on Sapphire Table in Noctilum.

Forest Apricas (Japanese: , Foresuto Dometomu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aprica family and can be found at level 22-26 at the Garden Spring, FN Site 221, or in the Canopied Nightwood in Noctilum during the day. They can drop the Fine Aprica Wood needed for From Idea to Inventory.
Flash Grenade is a Debuff Battle Art in . It can temporarily make an enemy flinch if its Debuff resistance is low enough.
Fleet Evellos (Japanese: , Fasuto Sutorutto, Fast Evello) are enemies in . They are members of the Evello family, and can be found at level 21-24 in Primordia, near FN Site 115.

Foggy Dilemma (Japanese: , Gorimuchū no Mondai) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received at the Water Purification Plant in the Residential District. Completing this mission unlocks Phog as a recruitable party member.
Frightening Ictuses (Japanese: , Sukeā Manda, Scare Ictus) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ictus family, and can be found at level 40 around FN Site 309 in Oblivia.
Fritz is a Human in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Flame Lophids (Japanese: , Furaimu Rofiru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lophid family, and can be found at level 35-36 near FN Site 505 in Cauldros.
Forest Adseculas (Japanese: , Foresuto Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 14-20 on Breakwater Narrow in Noctilum.

Fleet Aetrygons (Japanese: , Fasuto Derupinu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aetrygon family, and can be found at level 21-30 in Barbarich Desert or the FN Site 311 and the Azure Lagoon in Oblivia.
Fraisie (Japanese: , Furejii) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.

The Force Seidr (Japanese: , Fōsu Basugia) is a Story Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Seidr and appears at level 44 in O'rrh Sim Keep during Chapter 11, when the party infiltrates O'rrh Sim Castle to find Lao. When defeated, it drops a key which enables the party to open the large door between O'rrh Sim Keep and O'rrh Sim Gate, allowing Skells to enter the building.
Flecked Bottles (Japanese: , Dajiringu Botoru) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular around FN Site 108 at night or during thunderstorms.

Flowering Morrow Ferns (Japanese: , Morou Zenmai) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum. They can be obtained in the lake zone (including the blue grass zone) around FN Site 218 during early morning. Five of them are needed for Finding Morrows Today.
Fodornallow Greens (Japanese: , Fodorunarō Na) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.
Fraudulent Mirrors (Japanese: , Miwaku no Gōsutomirā) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.
Fluid Jaculs (Japanese: , Furou Hasutara, Flow Jacul) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Jacul family, and can be found at level 58-60 at Demon's Pocket in Oblivia.

Frajeel, the Purgatorial (Japanese: , Rengoku no Furajīru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Levitath family. It can be found at level 50 at the Divine Roost in Noctilum. Killing it is required for segment recon.
Fleeting Baboons (Japanese: , Mementohihi) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Flowering Eggs (Japanese: , Furawā Eggu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Florence, the Hell Maggot (Japanese: , Yōso no Burūmu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Germivore family. It can be found hidden at level 24 at Hilal Meadow at night in Sylvalum. It is too large to trample with a Skell.

Frenzied Coronids (Japanese: , Furenjī Regurī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Coronid family, and can be found at level 59-64 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during crimson auroras. They replace the normal-sized Ancient Coronids.

Foul Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Rasshi Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 51-70, specifically level 63 or level 65, in Bestial Utopia in Cauldros.

Formula Zero is a Light Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Formula Skell, and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.
Flowering Germivore Scales are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Germivores in Primordia, Noctilum, and Oblivia.

Floating Unafulges (Japanese: , Furōto Purumō) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Unafulge family, and can be found at level 23-24 around North Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum. Like most unafulges in Sylvalum, they may pop out of the ground when approached.

Fleet Shrads (Japanese: , Fasuto Zuttā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shrad machines and can be found at level 23-25 in Cauldros around White Phosphor Lake. They drop the Standard Blade Modules required for the affinity mission What the Skell?! as well as the Multi-Wire needed for the mission Material Hunt C, part of the affinity mission L's Conundrum.
Foucaultium is a Precious Resource in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Fleet Feet is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Partisan Eagle at rank 9. Cross and Celica can use this skill.
Flame Trigger is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Striker at rank 5.
Fortified Flesh is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Duelist at rank 5. Cross, Nagi and Alexa can use this skill.
Forfex Misos are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Forfexes.
Fresh Fish Meats are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Aetrygons and Xiphias.
From Idea to Inventory is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a general store manager to obtain Aprica Back Moss and the primary destination is Oblivia.

Flood Galdr (Japanese: , Furaddo Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 55 atop the flat-topped rock structure near Bedrock Hold in Primordia. They are dormant until approached.
Forbidden Love (Japanese: , Interijensu, Intelligence) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Loda Gorida in the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship.
Fluffy Tufts are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Mortifoles. Two are needed during A Tip of the Cap.
Flemtides (English dub: ) are Important Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Five pieces must be collected from the mineral deposits inside Stonelattice Cavern in Primordia during Fathers and Sons.

Forest Foray (Japanese: , Shokubutsu Chōsa) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sullivan inside the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District in New Los Angeles.
Fozimure is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles during the night.
Friendship Treatise is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located inside the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles, between Elma and Cross in the evening.

Fortun is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is first mentioned during Rites of Ruin and is registered on the Affinity Chart. She is first encountered during Good Fortun, and can be found in the Central Industrial District after the mission is completed. After Fortun and Glory is completed, she can be found at the top of BLADE Tower in the Administrative District. Fortun is the queen of the Definians. Her affinity chart profile identifies her race as "Fortun".

Fortun and Glory (Japanese: , Tabidachi, Departure) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from HT665: Erio in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. Depending on the route chosen during Definian Downfall, this mission or Definian Love is triggered.
Fossilized Bones are unique materials in . They can be obtained from Millepods. They are one of the components of the Infinite and True series of BLADE Wear.

Flaming Rocks are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Gularth, or for 50 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components of Melee: TP Gain Up and Custom.WP-M-GP augments.

Flowering Papil Scales are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Papils in Noctilum, Sylvalum, and Cauldros, or for 34 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in all Vehicle.DEBUFF-RES augments.
Forfex A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red forfex variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Sven, the Sturdy at NLA Waters.
Forfex B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white forfex variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Tourteau, the Delectable in Primordia.
Forfex C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue forfex variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Schneider, the Cliffpercher in Noctilum.
Foot Soldiers is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts three white-armored male Wrothian soldiers. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Plans of Attack.

* Foul Feeding Petramands is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Petramands. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Follow the Leader is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.10, and is unlocked if the two Simius are defeated during The Lone Giant. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Fortress Fight is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.10, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Vendura's Galdrs. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Freak Show is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.14, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting six Diluses. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Frenzied Cinicula is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.15, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Hephaestus, the Absconders. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Frightened Saltat is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed. It allows the player to quickly raise affinity with party members, and earn Division Points to raise one's BLADE Level. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Food Grudge is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed. It allows the player to quickly raise affinity with party members, and earn Division Points to raise one's BLADE Level. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Formal Suits are Casual Wear full body armor made by Sakuraba Industries in and . Shirtless versions of this armour can be acquired as the Dark Suit and Agent's Suit.

Focused Evasion is a ground armor special Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases evasion while within an enemy's melee range. A party member is in melee range when the position indicator on the battle HUD flashes red; an alarm sound plays when this range is entered.
Fog Screen is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that nullifies the debuffs from fog weather. The Skell equivalent is Weather.FOG-RES.
Front Attack Plus is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that increases damage dealt when attacking from the front of an enemy. The Skell equivalent is PositionDmg.FRONT.

Frame Patches are Consumable Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be received as Division Rewards for Division activities. They can be used during battle to restore Skell Frame HP to maximum for all party Skells currently in operation.

Flinch is a mobility debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Flinch causes those affected by it to suddenly freeze up. It will interrupt the casting of Battle Arts. Its effect is similar to Stun, but lasts much shorter. In addition to being inflicted by Arts, Flinch can be inflicted when an enemy initiates battle with the party. Being higher level than the enemy can reduce the chance of being Flinched. Skells are immune to this manner of Flinch, and players cannot Flinch if swimming.
